# 1. Environnement

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra) # Afficher plusieurs ggplots en meme temps
```

# 2. working directory

```{r}
  # Working diretory
setwd(here::here("Data", "Data entomo"))
here()
```

# 3. 

```{r}
  # IMPORT Jeu de données coléoptères
Coleo <- read.table("jeu_donnees_coleo.txt", sep = "\t", dec = ".", quote = "\"", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T) %>%
  select(6 : 7, 10 : 20)

  # Calcul de l'abondance par piège
abondance <- Coleo %>%
  group_by(Numero_de_piege) %>%
  summarise(Abondance = sum(Abondance))
  # Graphique de visualisation 
ab <- ggplot(abondance, aes(x = Numero_de_piege, y = Abondance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = c("darkgreen", "#458B00", "#556B2F", "#9ACD32")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Abondance), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Abondance de coléoptères saproxyliques le long des arbres Thèses",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Abondance (n)") +
  ylim(0, 10000) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

  # 
div_coleo <- Coleo %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(SP = ifelse(SP == "", NA, SP),
         nbesp = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SP)) %>%
  group_by(Numero_de_piege) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp))

div <- ggplot(div_coleo, aes(x = Numero_de_piege, y = nbesp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = c("darkgreen", "#458B00", "#556B2F", "#9ACD32")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = nbesp), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Diversité spécifique dans chaque pièges des arbres Thèses",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Diversité spécifique") +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
  # Faire apparaître 2 ggplot en même temps
grid.arrange(ab, div, ncol = 2)

library(FactoMineR)
Coleopca <- Coleo %>%
  select(8, 9, 11, 13) %>%
  mutate(code_sp = ifelse((is.na(GEN) | GEN == "") & (is.na(SP) | SP == ""), "INC",
         paste(GEN, SP, sep = "_"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(code_sp)) # Vérif des NAs

Coleopca <- Coleopca %>%
  setNames(c("GEN", "SP", "AB", "Num_piege", "code_sp")) %>%
  mutate(AB = as.numeric(AB)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 4 : 5, names_to = "code_sp", values_to = "AB") 



coleo.pca = PCA(Coleo[, 8 : 13], scale.unit = T, quali.sup = 8 : 10, graph = T)
plot.PCA(coleo.pca, axes = c(1,2), choix = , habillage = )
```
